title: A ray from the Sun
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth. Looking at the Sun is therefore seeing the surface as it was minutes earlier.

misconception: A learner may choose: It left at that exact instant
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: When sunlight reaches Earth, which is true about when it left the Sun?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: When sunlight reaches Earth, which is true about when it left the Sun? It left several minutes earlier. Sunlight takes about eight minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth. Looking at the Sun is therefore seeing the surface as it was minutes earlier.
Visual caption: Sunlight travels minutes. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: When sunlight reaches Earth, which is true about when it left the Sun?
options: It left at that exact instant
recall.why: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth. Looking at the Sun is therefore seeing the surface as it was minutes earlier.
